div.head: Wer 6
div.ab: Of ðam dæge, ðe ðæt healsfang agolden sy, on XXI nihtan gylde man ða manbote; ðæs on XXI nihtan ðæt fyhtewite; ðæs on XXI nihtan ðæs weres ðæt frumgyld; ⁊ swa forð, þæt fulgolden sy on ðam fyrste, ðe witan geræden.

Of ðam dæge, þe þæt healsfang agolden sy, on XXI nihtan gylde man ða manbote; ðæs on XXI nihtan þæt fyht[e]wite; ðæs on XXI nihtan ðæs weres þæt frumgyld; ⁊ swa forð, þæt fulgolden sy on ðam fyrste, ðe witan geræddan.

A die illa qua healsfangum redditum sit, in XXI. noctem reddatur manbota; inde in XXI. noctem fihtƿita (id est forisfactura pugne); inde ad XXI. noctem ipsius were frumgildum (id est prima redditio); et sic postea, donec persoluatur infra terminum, quem sapientes instituent.

Von dém Tage, da das Halsfanggeld entrichtet ist, in 21 Tagen zahle man [dem Herrn des Erschlagenen] Busse für Erschlagung des Untergebenen; von dem ab in 21 Tagen die Strafe für Blutvergiessen [an die Obrigkeit]; von dem ab in 21 Tagen die Erstzahlung des Wergeldes [an die Sippe]; und so weiter, damit [es] vollbezahlt sei in der Frist, welche die notablen Schiedsmannen bestimmen (-mt haben B).

Within 21 days from the day the healsfang is paid, let one pay [to the slain man's lord] the compensation for killing his man; within 21 days from then the fine for fighting [to the authorities]; within 21 days from then the first payment of the wergild [to the kin]; and so on, so that [it] is fully paid within the term which the notable arbitrators determine (have determined, B).

From the day when healsfang is to be paid, within twenty-one days, manbot is to be paid; then within twenty-one days the fighting-fine; then within twenty-one days the first instalment of the wergeld; and so on, until full payment is made within the time-limit that the witan have ordained.

note.seg: Benutzt durch Hn 76, 7 mit wichtigen Zusätzen.—In II Em klingt þæs archaischer, auch fehlt dort der Artikel vor manbot
Used by Hn 76, 7 with important additions. — In II Em þæs sounds more archaic; the article before manbot is also missing there

Blutig (s. d. Gl 3) fechten kostet staatliches Strafgeld bereits im 7. Jh., aber vielleicht nur, wenn die Sache vor den staatlichen Richter kam. Denkbar ist daher, dass die Vorlage über private Totschlagsühne keine Fechtstrafe nannte, wie II Em 7, 3⁴; vgl. Gl Schiedsgericht 9f.

Fighting with bloodshed (see Blutig in Gl 3) already incurs a public fine in the 7th cent., but perhaps only if the case came before the public judge. It is therefore conceivable that the source on private settlement of homicide named no penalty for fighting, like II Em 7, 3⁴; cf. Gl Schiedsgericht 9f.
Ein Wort in Hss.; das Kompositum fehlt Wbb. Vgl. II Em 1: forgolden be fullan were
One word in the MSS; the compound is missing from the dictionaries. Cf. II Em 1: forgolden be fullan were
Des Erschlagenen Sippe setzt die Frist laut Hn; ‘ein Jahr’ scheint genetisch jünger II Em 1
According to Hn the slain man’s kindred sets the term; ‘a year’ in II Em 1 seems genetically later
